identity.name: Makwanpur Multiple Campus
identity.short_description: Makwanpur Multiple Campus is a leading community-based campus located in Hetauda, Makwanpur, affiliated with Tribhuvan University.
identity.description: Established in 1981 AD (2038 BS), Makwanpur Multiple Campus is one of the premier higher education institutions in the Bagmati Province of Nepal. Located in Hetauda Sub-Metropolitan City, it offers a wide range of undergraduate and graduate programs in Humanities, Management, Education, and Science under Tribhuvan University.

recognition_details: Recognized by University Grants Commission Nepal

academics.academic_calendar: As per Tribhuvan University academic calendar
academics.teaching_methodology: Lectures, practicals, presentations, and field assignments.

programs.name: Bachelor of Business Studies (BBS)
programs.eligibility: +2 or equivalent in any stream with minimum second division.

programs.name: Master of Business Studies (MBS)
programs.eligibility: Bachelor degree in Business/Management or equivalent from TU.

admission.guidance: Admissions are conducted according to Tribhuvan University guidelines and academic calendars.
requirements: Passed +2 or equivalent for undergraduate programs
Passed Bachelor degree for postgraduate programs
application_process: Submit application form online or physically at the campus administration.
admission.entrance_details: Entrance exams required for specific programs like MBS (CMAT).

scholarships.name: UGC and Campus Merit Scholarships
scholarships.eligibility: Based on academic performance and economic background.
scholarships.benefits: Partial or full tuition fee waiver
scholarships.application_process: Apply through campus administration office during admission period.

institutional_profile.mission: To provide quality higher education accessible to diverse communities in Makwanpur district.
institutional_profile.vision: To be a center of excellence in higher education and professional development.
milestones: Successfully operating for over four decades.

student_life.campus_experience: Vibrant campus environment with diverse student participation.
